questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation. 25 * 2 * 220 * 11 * 43
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.
25 * 2 * 220 * 11 * 43
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule,

Given equation : 25 * 2 * 220 * 11 * 43

1) Using the combination : +, –, ×, =

25 + 2  – 220 × 11 = 43

25 + 2 - 2420 = 43

27 - 2420 = 43

2393 ≠ 43 

2) Using the combination : +, –, ÷, =

25 + 2 – 220 ÷ 11 = 43

25 + 2 - 20 = 43

27 - 20 = 43

7  ≠ 43 

3) Using the combination :  +, +, ÷, =

25 + 2 +  220 ÷ 11 = 43

25 + 2 + 20 =43

47 ≠ 43 

4)  Using the combination : –, +, ÷, =

25 – 2 + 220 ÷ 11 = 43

25 - 2 + 20 = 43

45 - 2 = 43

43 = 43

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the # signs and to balance the given equation.
[{(44 # 38) # (2 # 5)} # (4 # 2)] # 5 # 10
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule

Given expression : [{(44 # 38) # (2 # 5)} # (4 # 2)] # 5 # 10

Option 1) ×, ÷, ×, ×, –, +, = 

[{(44 × 38) ÷ (2 × 5)} × (4 – 2)] + 5 = 10

[{1672 ÷ 10} × 8] + 5 = 10

[167.2 × 8] + 5 = 10

1337.6 + 5 = 10

1342.6 ≠ 10

Option 2) ×, –, +, ×, ÷, ×, = 

[{(44 × 38) - (2 + 5)} × (4 ÷ 2)] × 5 = 10

[{1672  - 7} × (8)] × 5 = 10

[1665 × (8)] × 5 = 10

13320 × 5 = 10

66600  ≠ 10

Option 3)  –, +, ×, ×, ÷, ×, =  

[{(44 - 38) + (2 × 5)} × (4 ÷ 2)] × 5 = 10

[{(6) + (10)} × (2)] × 5 = 10

[16 × (2)] × 5 = 10

32 × 5 = 10

160 ≠ 10

Option 4)  –, +, ×, ÷, ×, ×, =

[{(44 - 38) + (2 × 5)} ÷ (4 × 2)] × 5 = 10

[{(6) + (10)} ÷ (8)] × 5 = 10

[16 ÷ (8)] × 5 = 10

2 × 5 = 10

10 = 10

Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.

questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be correct?
+ and –, 7 and 6
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule,

By interchanging signs + and –, 7 and 6 by one by one option

1) 4 × 7 + 6 – 3 ÷ 1 = 20

4 × 6 - 7 + 3 ÷ 1 = 20

4 × 6 - 7 + 3 = 20

24 - 7 + 3 = 20

27 - 7 = 20

20 = 20

2) 8 × 7 + 5 ÷ 1 – 6 = 17

8 × 6 - 5 ÷ 1 + 7 = 17

48 - 5 + 7 = 17 

50 ≠ 17

3) 7 – 6 × 3 + 4 ÷ 1 = 8

 6 + 7 × 3 - 4 ÷ 1 = 8

6 + 21 - 4 = 8

23 ≠ 8

4) 7 × 2 – 6 + 4 ÷ 2 = 13

6 × 2 + 7 - 4 ÷ 2 = 13

12 + 7 - 2 = 13

17 ≠ 13

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: The Constitution of India is a sovereign socialist secular democratic republic with a _________ system of government.
questions.questionHtml: The Constitution of India is a sovereign socialist secular democratic republic with a _________ system of government.
questions.solution: India has a parliamentary system of government and is a sovereign socialist secular democratic republic. The Prime Minister heads the Council of Ministers and the President is the constitutional leader. The Constitution governs the country since January 26, 1950.

questions.question: Ahmadnagar was finally annexed by the Mughals in _____.
questions.questionHtml: Ahmadnagar was finally annexed by the Mughals in _____.
questions.solution: Ahmadnagar was ruled by the Nizam Shahi dynasty in the Deccan region. It was established as a capital in 1494 by Malik Ahmed. In 1637, it was annexed by the Mughal Empire under Aurangzeb's rule.

questions.question: Which of the following major Indian crops requires high temperature (above 25°C) and high humidity?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following major Indian crops requires high temperature (above 25°C) and high humidity?
questions.solution: Rice is a major Indian crop that requires high temperature and humidity, with an annual precipitation of at least 100 cm. It is farmed in northern and northeastern plains, coastal regions, and deltaic areas. Rice is made from the seed of Oryza sativa or O. glaberrima, while wild rice refers to species of Zizania and Porteresia.

questions.question: ______ time graph shows speed of an object.
questions.questionHtml: ______ time graph shows speed of an object.
questions.solution: A distance-time graph shows the speed of an object. The gradient of the line is equal to the object's speed, with steeper lines indicating faster movement. Distance is the sum of an object's movements regardless of direction, and can be defined as the amount of space covered. Velocity is the direction an object is moving, displacement is the shortest distance between two points, and acceleration is the rate of change of velocity over time.

questions.question: Which nutrient is chlorella rich in?
questions.questionHtml: Which nutrient is chlorella rich in?
questions.solution: Chlorella is a nutrient-dense alga that is rich in protein. Protein is a crucial macronutrient that is necessary for the growth and repair of tissues in the body. It is also involved in the production of haemoglobin, enzymes, and other essential molecules. Chlorella contains all of the essential amino acids, making it a complete protein source.

questions.question: McMahon line is a line which separates China and which Indian state?
questions.questionHtml: McMahon line is a line which separates China and which Indian state?
questions.solution: McMahon Line separates China and the Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh. It is a disputed border, and Arunachal Pradesh shares international boundaries with Bhutan and Myanmar in the west and east, respectively. Arunachal Pradesh is the largest state in Northeast India and is home to various ethnic groups, including Monpa, Tani, Mishmi, Tai, and Naga.

questions.question: The Paris Indian Society was an Indian nationalist organisation founded in ______.
questions.questionHtml: The Paris Indian Society was an Indian nationalist organisation founded in ______.
questions.solution: The correct answer is 1905. The Paris Indian Society was an Indian nationalist organisation founded in that year. Indian nationalism, which embraces all of India's residents despite their different racial, linguistic, and religious heritage, had its roots in pre-colonial India, but it was fully developed during the movement for Indian independence from British rule. The Indian Association, the first openly nationalist group, was established in British India in 1876 by Surendranath Banerjee and Ananda Mohan Bose, and with coordinated anti-colonial coalitions and activities, Indian nationalism soon gained momentum in India.

questions.question: Droupadi Murmu was elected the _______ President of India.
questions.questionHtml: Droupadi Murmu was elected the _______ President of India.
questions.solution: Droupadi Murmu was elected as the 15th President of India, making her the second woman and the first member of a tribal community to hold this position. She was born on June 20, 1958, and is also the youngest person to hold this position. Her father and grandfather were traditional leaders in their local council. She was given the name Puti Tudu by her family and later changed to Droupadi by her teacher.

questions.question: What is the commercial unit of electric energy?
questions.questionHtml: What is the commercial unit of electric energy?
questions.solution: The commercial unit of electric energy is the kilowatt hour (kWh). It is defined as the amount of energy used by a 1kW appliance for one hour. Although not a formal standard unit, it is commonly used in electrical applications. Commercial units are charged at a higher rate than household units to reduce power usage in factories and other settings.

questions.question: In early 1610, who discovered with his newly invented telescope that Jupiter has four moons?
questions.questionHtml: In early 1610, who discovered with his newly invented telescope that Jupiter has four moons?
questions.solution: Galileo Galilei discovered with his newly invented telescope that Jupiter has four moons in early 1610. He was an Italian astronomer, physicist, and engineer who is known as the "Father of modern science". Galileo engaged in practical science and technology, developed the thermoscope, created military compasses, and made use of the telescope to study celestial objects.

questions.question: Rukmani Devi Arundale was a famous dancer of which Indian classical dance form?
questions.questionHtml: Rukmani Devi Arundale was a famous dancer of which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale was a famous Indian theosophist, animal rights advocate, and Bharatanatyam dancer and choreographer. She was instrumental in reviving the original "Sadhir" style of Bharatanatyam, which was popular among Devadasi temple dancers. Bharatanatyam is a classical Indian dance form that has been influenced by South Indian religions, primarily Shaivism, Vaishnavism, and Shaktism. Rukmini Devi Arundale was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1956 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship in 1967 for her contributions to Indian arts and culture.

questions.question: If \(\sec θ - 2\cos θ = \frac{7}{2}\) , where θ is a positive acute angle, then the value of sec θ is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(\sec θ - 2\cos θ = \frac{7}{2}\), where θ is a positive acute angle, then the value of sec θ is:
questions.solution:
\(\sec θ - 2\cos θ = \frac{7}{2}\)

⇒  \(\sec θ - \frac{2}{\sec θ} = \frac{7}{2}\)

⇒  sec²θ - 2 = 7secθ/2 ⇒  2sec²θ - 7 secθ - 4 = 0

⇒  2sec²θ +  (- 8 + 1) secθ - 4 = 0

⇒  2secθ(secθ - 4) + 1(secθ - 4) = 0

⇒  (2secθ + 1)(secθ - 4) = 0 ⇒  secθ = -1/2, 4

θ is positive acute angle so, secθ = 4

questions.question: If mx m – nx n = 0, then what is the value of \(\frac{1}{{{x^m} + {x^n}}} + \frac{1}{{{x^m} - {x^n}}}\) in terms of x n is: Where x, m, n are > 0
questions.questionHtml:
If mxm – nxn = 0, then what is the value of \(\frac{1}{{{x^m} + {x^n}}} + \frac{1}{{{x^m} - {x^n}}}\) in terms of xn is:

Where x, m, n are > 0
questions.solution:
\(\frac{m}{n} = \frac{x^n}{x^m}\) so, m = xn and n = xm

\(\frac{1}{{{x^m} + {x^n}}} + \frac{1}{{{x^m} - {x^n}}}\) ⇒ \(\frac{1}{{{n} + {m}}} + \frac{1}{{{n} - {m}}}\) ⇒ \(\frac{2n}{n^2 - m^2}\)

Multiply and Divide the expression by xn ⇒ \(\frac{2n}{n^2 - m^2}\times \frac{x^n}{x^n}\)

Now substitute m = xn in the numerator  ⇒ \(\frac{2mn}{x^n(n^2 - m^2)}\)

questions.solution:
M1D2 = M2D2

⇒ (M + 4W) × 65/4 = (3M + 4W) × 13/2

⇒ M/W = 12/1 so, efficiency of M = 12, W = 1

Total work = (12 + 4 × 1) × 65/4 = 260

Time taken by 13 women =  260/13 = 20 days

Distance travel by Train B = 72 × 4 = 288 km

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation. Always be in ______ with your near and dear ones as life is uncertain and fragile.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation.

Always be in ______ with your near and dear ones as life is uncertain and fragile.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "touch".

Key Points

  • The correct collocation is "be in touch".
  • Let's understand its meaning:
  • Be in touch: it refers to continuing a conversation or point of contact with someone. Because life can be unpredictable, it's crucial to stay in touch with your loved ones. Doing so can develop bonds and offer emotional support.
    • Example:
      • I intentionally try to be in touch with my friends and family, even if it's only a quick message or phone call.
      • We need to be in touch with the latest trends and technologies if we want our business to stay competitive.
  • It is apparent from the above explanation that the correct word for the given sentence is "touch".
     

Therefore, the complete sentence is: Always be in touch with your near and dear ones as life is uncertain and fragile.

Additional Information

  •  Let's know more about the rest of the options:
  • The other possibilities on the list are also concerned with relationships and communication, but they don't quite match the sentence's context as well.
  • The words "relation" and "connection" could be used instead, although "touch" is the most typical collocation.
  • The term "communication" is too general and fails to convey the significance of preserving a long-term relationship.

questions.question: Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order. The decision not P. to include any kind of wealth or Q. crisis, has proven controversial R. income tax, which would be the fairer option S. for solving the social care funding
questions.questionHtml:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

The decision not
P. to include any kind of wealth or
Q. crisis, has proven controversial
R. income tax, which would be the fairer option
S. for solving the social care funding
questions.solution: The correct answer is: B. PRSQ. The sentence begins with "The decision not," which logically requires an infinitive verb to follow. Part (P) "to include any kind of wealth or" provides this. Part (R) "income tax, which would be the fairer option" completes the noun phrase started in (P). Part (S) "for solving the social care funding" explains the purpose of the tax, and part (Q) "crisis, has proven controversial" completes the noun phrase from (S) and provides the main verb phrase for the entire sentence. The full sentence reads: "The decision not to include any kind of wealth or income tax, which would be the fairer option for solving the social care funding crisis, has proven controversial."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "The art and science of designing buildings is called architecture".

Key Points

  • Option 2) "The art and science of designing buildings is called architecture" is the correct sentence without a spelling error.
  • Spelling errors occur when words are not written correctly, either by missing, adding, or swapping letters.
  • In this case, option 1 has a spelling error in the word "architecchure".
  • Option 3 has a spelling error in the word "archtiecture".
  • Option 4 has a spelling error in the word "architectrue", where the "u" and "e" are swapped.
     

Therefore, the correct sentence is: The art and science of designing buildings is called architecture.

Additional Information

  • Let's understand the meaning of the correct word:
  • Architecture: the art or practice of designing and constructing buildings.
    • Example:
      • Schools of architecture and design are rare in our country.
      • He is studying architecture in London.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate collocation to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence. We congratulated him at his new job. He was delighted.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate collocation to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

We congratulated him at his new job. He was delighted.
questions.solution: The correct answer is "congratulated him on". Congratulated him on: to compliment someone and express approval or happiness on a noteworthy or exceptional accomplishment. Example: He congratulated me on my wedding. It is apparent from the explanation that "congratulated him on" is an appropriate collocation instead of "congratulated him at".

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. Both Reeta and Ronika / has won / the dance competition / this year.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Both Reeta and Ronika / has won / the dance competition / this year.
questions.solution: The segment that contains a grammatical error is "has won". The subject of the sentence is "Both Reeta and Ronika", which is a plural subject. The correct sentence would be "Both Reeta and Ronika have won the dance competition this year" as "have won" correctly agrees with the plural subject "Both Reeta and Ronika".

  • The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3 is "diverse".

  • As a result, migration patterns are not uniform or constant, but rather diverse and variable.
  • Because migration decisions are influenced by a variety of factors, the resulting patterns are diverse and complex.
    • Example: The views of people of this country on sports are diverse.
  • Thus, "diverse" is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
